--  Notes:- Removed Lower from natco_code as there is no value in caps
--  Internalemployee filter is always no only in whole dataset so removeng additional filters

WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT
      event_date as date
	  ,action
	  ,session_id
	  ,log_time
 
 
    FROM 
      silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
 page_name like '%checkout%'
	    
	 and {{date}}
      AND (
        'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
        OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
        OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
      )
      --   AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
      AND natco_code = 'de'
      AND (
        'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
        OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
      )
      AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
			  		AND (
'All' IN ({{category}})
OR category = {{category}}
OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
)
	  

  )


 
,
purchase_success_sessions as
(
SELECT DISTINCT date,session_id, from_unixtime (log_time / 1000) as end_time
FROM base WHERE action = 'purchaseSuccess'
)

,end_time_cte as
(
SELECT session_id, min(from_unixtime (log_time / 1000)) as start_time  FROM base
GROUP BY 1
)
,base2 AS
(
SELECT
	a.session_id, date_diff ('minute',start_time,end_time) as exit_time,
	start_time, end_time
FROM purchase_success_sessions a
LEFT JOIN end_time_cte b on a.session_id = b.session_id
)
,base3 as
(
SELECT session_id, sum(exit_time) as time_spend
FROM base2
WHERE exit_time <= 20 group by 1
)

SELECT 
	round(avg(time_spend),1) as avg_time_spend
from 
	base3
